profile.summary: Backend Developer voi 4 nam kinh nghiem xay dung he thong microservices va API hieu nang cao cho san pham fintech & e-commerce. Thich viet code sach, co kien thuc de bao tri.

work_evidence.company: Cong ty TNHH Cong nghe Fin Pay
responsibilities_and_impact: Thiet ke va phat trien 15+ microservices xu ly hon 2 trieu giao dich/thang bang Spring Boot & Kafka.
Toi truong truy van PostgreSQL, giam 40% thoi gian phan hoi API cho nghiep vu thanh toan.
Xay dung pipeline CI/CD voi Jenkins & Docker, rut ngan thoi gian deploy tu 1 gio xuong 10 phut.
Mentor 3 thuc tap sinh backend, xay dung tai lieu coding convention cho team.
Phat trien module quan ly don hang va ton kho bang Node.js/Express, phuc vu 50,000+ nguoi dung.
Tich hop cong thanh toan VNPay, Momo, Zalo Pay vao he thong checkout.
Viet unit test & integration test, tang do phu code tu 45% len 80%.

project_evidence: He thong quan ly don hang da kenh cho chuoi ban le, xu ly dong bo real-time cho web, app va POS.
Service phat hien giao dich bat thuong theo thoi gian su dung rule-engine, giam 30% giao dich gian lan.
